Remember to conduct an interview as soon as you can after claiming a post, because it cannot be predicted when an interviewee may respond to you. You don't want to message an interviewe right before the post deadline!
Your name in the sign-off can be colored with any custom color! More so, your name can have a fancy gradient effect or simply have multiple colors.

Use the [CPA Media Reference Sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlH7i96flqBZwUM7CM1hj5MjzTLiTeuAtyTEfyJX_fA/edit?usp=sharing) to find army name colors, organization colors, tournament colors, the column calendar, the checklist, the scoring rubric, and recognized transition words. It is a complete suite for quick information that you might need while writing!
Spell out numbers ten and below, unless they are an army's size at an event. Digitize numbers larger than ten.
Names of Club Penguin private servers, such as Club Penguin Journey, should only be bolded. They should not be colored.

Use of AI is prohibited for creating content, as it is known for plagiarism and cannot reliably give accurate facts. However, you can use AI for rephrasing language or writing generic text. If you are not fluent in English, you may also use a translator!
Reporting Guide is a living document that can answer most of your questions regarding formatting and research.

If you are writing an SEO meta description for your post, don't copy the introduction paragraph from your post and paste it! Instead, write something fresh that can hook a viewer who has not yet opened the post.
Ideally, questions should start with different first words. For example, you can have questions starting with "what", "why", or "how". The goal is to avoid using the same question word repeatedly.

If you need to determine the structure of a post manually, try filling your post with placeholders first. This can be a rough sketch that gives you some idea on what to write and where. Each paragraph should have a different theme while staying relevant to the central topic.

Pengauthor was launched in July 2026 and shifted many reporters from the traditional way to a more modern way. In summary, Pengauthor allows reporters to access post skeletons, complete checklists, read writing instructions, and more. This does not mean that using Pengauthor is required, however.

You can set up your personal profile on the Club Penguin Armies dashboard. Your profile, including the biography, will appear under each post you author. To change what is shown, visit Profile through the dashboard sidebar, and scroll to the About Yourself section.
You can switch between the Visual and Code editors of a post. Both will result in the same content, just a different way of editing. This is worth knowing if you want to leverage Pengauthor!
The correct way to format a date is `[Month] [Day], [Year]`! You can omit the year if the context makes it clear. Don't add ordinals like "st", "nd", "rd", or "th".
Never forget adding the `Club Penguin Armies` and `CPA` tags. They are called "evergreen tags", as they are always added irrespective of what the post is about!
Aside from adding the thumbnail after the post's introduction paragraph, you also set the thumbnail as the Featured image. You can do so on at the bottom of the post's metadata sidebar.
Interview questions are always Heading 3, and bolded. You might feel that bolding does not make a difference in the post editor, but it makes a noticeable difference in the actual post!

Interview questions produced by Pengauthor in the boilerplate generator are not AI-generated! A wide range of questions have been written by certain Reporting Heads and can be used in most cases. [See the complete dataset here.](https://github.com/FunXTime/Pengauthor/blob/main/config/questionnaire.json)
Ending questions should always be placed at the end of the conclusion paragraph. They should be italicized, and should sound neutral. Generally, two such questions should suffice.
Names of interviewees are always added as tags, irrespective of whether they are relevant to the topic.
Non-opinion posts cannot contain personal pronouns like "I", "me", or "myself". These may only be used in opinion posts. It is worth noting that satire posts are always considered opinion posts.
Don't invite the reader to "read more", "keep reading", or "find out more", as it is inadequate. Instead, speak what your post truly contains to make it promising and hook them into reading further.

There are two sources from which you can fetch information — primary sources and secondary sources. The former includes first-hand accounts of events that have transpired, such as announcements on Discord or army websites, judging results, and so on. On the other hand, secondary sources include second-hand information, such as interviews from eyewitnesses and data from historical archives.
An image caption shouldn't end in a period (.).

Spot The Error is a special game the Reporting Team runs that tests your editing skills. If you are aspiring to be a Reporting Head or a professional Senior Reporter, this game is an excellent option to begin with. [Start a challenge.](https://cpa-pengauthor.vercel.app/spot-the-error)

You can make quick questions! You can reach out to an individual and ask them a question relevant to the topic you're writing. Their answer can be blockquoted between paragraphs. These are not exactly part of an interview, but they enrich your post while keeping the formatting consistent.

Reporters-in-Training must complete two posts without using Pengauthor's boilerplate generator in order to be promoted to Reporter. It does not matter what score was obtained. This rule has been set to use the traditional way of reporting to help create a better idea of formatting in the reporter's mind.

Avoid claiming too many posts at once with deadlines close to each other. The gap between the deadlines really depends on your position in the Media Department, but try focusing on just one post at a time when you can!

The Senior Reporter role can be thought of as an "Associate Editor in Training" position, as Senior Reporters are trained to be skilled editors. Therefore, Senior Reporters receive the same rights as editors on the Club Penguin Armies website. The next Associate Editor is generally picked from the pool of Senior Reporters!

Read other posts to learn more about formatting and writing. If you believe any detail of the post is improper and does not comply with the reporting guidelines, share your input. Observation will build your reporting skills without even realizing it!
It is encouraged to have a minimum post length of roughly 300 words. Reach or go beyond that, and your post should give good vibes.

Em dashes (—) should always be surrounded by spaces. This is the convention that Club Penguin Armies follows. However, this spacing convention does not apply to the shorter en dashes (–), which are used to define a range, such as 2022–2026.
You are expected to share the questions you asked for an interview in your personal thread, so that editors know what the community is being asked! They may also suggest improvements.
The horizontal line of a post appears like a full-width, thin, black line in the post editor. However, it really appears like a short, thick, blue line in the actual, user-facing post.

Refrain from using contractions such as "let's" or "they'll" in formal reporting; please use the full forms, such as "let us" and "they will", instead. You may use contractions within op-ed pieces, however.
Time should be written in this 12-hour format with EST as the time zone: "12 pm EST."
